prompts.text: Name an athlete who has competed at the Summer Olympics (any country, any sport, up to Paris 2024)

Name a sport or discipline that has been part of the Summer or Winter Olympics (any Games, 1896 to 2026)
Name an official Olympic or Paralympic Games mascot (up to Milan Cortina 2026)
Name a country that won at least one medal of any colour at the Paris 2024 Olympics
Name a British Paralympic gold medallist (Summer or Winter, up to Paris 2024)
Name a British Olympic gold medallist in cycling (track, road, BMX or mountain bike, 1908 to Paris 2024)
Name a British Olympic gold medallist in rowing (1984 to Paris 2024, including coxes)
Name a British Olympic medallist in swimming or diving (any colour, individual or synchro events, 1976 to Paris 2024)
Name a gymnast who has won an Olympic medal (artistic, rhythmic or trampoline, any country, up to Paris 2024)
